expressions.photo.introText: Send one photo to the image model your team connected and turn it into an emoji.
expressions.photo.checkFailed: Could not check the image model. Please try again.
expressions.photo.noModelDetail: The connected models cannot draw pictures. Connect an OpenAI or Gemini image model to use this.
expressions.photo.noModelAsk: The server operator connects models. Ask your operator.
expressions.photo.photoHint: Use a still PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MiB.
expressions.photo.cutoutHint: Keeps the subject as it is and makes the background transparent.
expressions.photo.caricatureHint: Draws a new caricature based on the photo.
expressions.photo.faceOtherBlocked: Only a single picture of your own face can be approved. Please do not upload other people's faces.
expressions.photo.fixedNote: The name and picture cannot be changed after registering.
expressions.photo.consent: I agree to send my photo to {provider}. The cost is billed to the key your team connected.
expressions.photo.cutoutModel: The model drew a transparent background.
expressions.photo.cutoutUnchanged: The background could not be removed. The preview below is what will be saved.
expressions.photo.photoType: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF photo.
expressions.photo.photoSize: The photo is too large. Choose one up to 5 MiB.
expressions.photo.consentMissing: You need to agree to sending the photo first.
expressions.photo.fieldsInvalid: Use 2 to 30 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens for the name, up to 40 characters for the display name and up to 8 tags.
expressions.photo.errorUnavailable: The connected key cannot use an image model. Connect an OpenAI or Gemini image model or check its access.
expressions.photo.errorChanged: The connected image model changed. Please check and agree again.
expressions.photo.errorRefused: The image model declined this photo. Try another photo.
expressions.photo.errorFailed: Could not draw the picture. Please try again shortly.
expressions.photo.errorTimeout: It took too long. Please try again.
expressions.photo.errorBusy: Other pictures are being drawn. Please try again shortly.
expressions.photo.errorQuota: You have too many pending drafts. Register one or try again in an hour.
expressions.photo.errorRole: You cannot add new pictures to this team right now.
expressions.photo.errorName: Check the name. Names that clash with standard emoji are not allowed.
expressions.photo.errorMedia: This photo cannot be opened. Choose another.
expressions.photo.errorOffline: You are offline. Try again when you are connected.
expressions.photo.errorGeneric: Could not make it. Check your connection and input, then try again.
